paper_title: A generic approach yields organic solar cells with enhanced efficiency and thermal stability
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Aggregate - 2022 - Gao - A generic approach yields organic solar cells with enhanced efficiency and thermal stability/auto/Aggregate - 2022 - Gao - A generic approach yields organic solar cells with enhanced efficiency and thermal stability.md

knowledge_points.content: Small-angle neutron scattering (SANS) requires a high scattering contrast (Δρ > 2 × 10⁻⁶ Å⁻²) between the polymer and solvent to accurately resolve solution-state structures, which is often unachievable with standard solvents like chloroform (CF) or o-dichlorobenzene (DCB).
knowledge_points.evidence: The Δρ values of these representative photovoltaic materials and common casting solvents are generally lower than 2 × 10−6 Å−2, which makes it challenging to analyze the SANS data... deuteration is a quite effective means to accurately reveal the solution structure of conjugated polymers.

knowledge_points.content: Deuterium substitution in organic solvents typically reduces the solubility parameter (δ) and increases the Flory-Huggins interaction parameter (χ), resulting in poorer miscibility between the polymer and the deuterated solvent compared to the protonated version.
knowledge_points.evidence: Deuterium substitution decreases the δ1, which in combination with the above equation yields an increase in the χ Thus, the deuterated solvent-polymer system is less miscible compared to the undeuterated solvent-polymer system.

knowledge_points.content: The use of deuterated chloroform (CF-d) for PTVT-T films results in higher crystallization (Tc = 292.9 °C) and melting temperatures (Tm = 396.4 °C) compared to standard chloroform (Tc = 290.7 °C, Tm = 365.6 °C), indicating more stable crystalline forms.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure 2A depicted that the thin film processed by CF-d has higher crystallization temperature (Tc = 292.9 °C) and melting temperature (Tm = 396.4 °C) compared with CF fabricated films (Tc = 290.7 °C, Tm = 365.6 °C).

knowledge_points.content: Films processed with deuterated solvents exhibit enhanced π-π stacking and higher relative degree of crystallinity (rDoC); for PTVT-T, the π-π stacking peak area in the out-of-plane direction is approximately 1.7 times larger when processed with CF-d compared to CF.
knowledge_points.evidence: CF-d processed films had stronger π-π stacking of backbone and a higher degree of self-organization... the π-π stacking peak area of CF-d film is about 1.7 times that of CF film, as reflected in Figure 2D.

knowledge_points.content: PTVT-T:BTP-eC9 organic solar cells processed with CF-d achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 14.96%, surpassing the 14.03% achieved with standard CF, primarily due to improvements in fill factor (FF) and short-circuit current (JSC).
knowledge_points.evidence: the best performing device based on CF as the solvent delivered an optimized PCE of 14.03%... While the optimized photovoltaic devices processed with CF-d attained an enhanced PCE of 14.96% with an increased FF of 74.7% JSC of 24.73 mA cm−2.

knowledge_points.content: Processing the PTVT-T:BTP-eC9 active layer with CF-d increases the extrapolated T80 thermal stability lifetime at 85 °C to approximately 8000 hours, which is nearly nine times higher than the lifetime of devices processed with standard CF.
knowledge_points.evidence: the CF-d-based devices... exhibited an extrapolated T80 lifetime of up to 8000 h... By comparison, the T80 of CF-based devices under the same annealing conditions is about one-ninth of that of CF-d-based devices.

knowledge_points.content: The hole mobility (μh) of PTVT-T neat films increases from 7.3 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ when processed with CF to 1.1 × 10⁻³ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ when processed with CF-d.
knowledge_points.evidence: The μh of PTVT-T neat film prepared with CF and CF-d were 7.3 × 10−4 cm2 V−1 s−1, and 1.1 × 10−3 cm2 V−1 s−1 respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Power spectral density (PSD) analysis of TEM images can be used to characterize phase purity in OSC blend films, with higher integrated intensity indicating higher purity and clearer phase interfaces.
knowledge_points.evidence: the integrated intensity from TEM PSD profiles could characterize the phase purity of the films to a certain extent... the blend film processed by CF-d had clear phase interfaces, slightly higher contrast, and integrated intensity from TEM PSD.

knowledge_points.content: The P3HT:O-IDTBR system reached a record-high efficiency of 7.69% when processed using the deuterated solvent CF-d.
knowledge_points.evidence: We have also verified the effectiveness of deuterated solvents to enhance device performance in the classical P3HT:O-IDTBR system, which also yields a promising efficiency of over 7.69%... 7.69% is above the prior record for P3HT:O-IDTBR system.

knowledge_points.content: Deuterated solvents promote a higher percentage of 'face-on' molecular orientation in blend films; for example, PTVT-T:BTP-eC9 films processed with CF-d showed 73% face-on orientation compared to 62% for CF-processed films.
knowledge_points.evidence: The film processed by CF-d exhibited a higher percentage of face-on orientation (73%) than CF-derived film (62%).

knowledge_points.content: The isotopic effect on device performance and morphology is not limited to chloroform; using deuterated o-dichlorobenzene (DCB-d) for PTVT-T:BTP-eC9 also resulted in higher JSC and a PCE of 15.75% compared to 14.89% for standard DCB.
knowledge_points.evidence: the PTVT-T:BTP-eC9 devices employing by DCB-d solvent afforded a higher JSC and PCE (Figure 7I)... DCB-d [PCE] (15.75%) [vs] DCB (14.89%).
